findings.summary: The demonstration does not name the config test that parses athena.toml, so nobody can see that this specific test ran with the new value.
findings.evidence: The repository config test is crates/athena-data/tests/repo_config.rs (found by grep for athena.toml in crates/**/tests). The plan only says 'the repository config parse test'. No test asserts the literal 1800 for producer_timeout_s (grep of crates/), and config.rs has no upper bound on it, so 3000 should parse. Fix: Also run `cargo test --locked -p athena-data --test repo_config` and quote its passing output next to the full-suite run.

findings.summary: The brief lists docs/system-facts.md as a deliverable, but the plan leaves it unchanged. That choice is reasonable, but it needs to be stated in the hand-off.
findings.evidence: A grep of docs/system-facts.md for 1800, deadline or timeout finds nothing. The request names only three files, and the reading says 'Three files only'. Fix: Keep system-facts.md unchanged, and state in the producer's output that this deliverable was dropped on purpose, so the verifier does not count it as missing.

findings.summary: The plan should give one insertion point, not two.
findings.evidence: Under [Unreleased] (line 8), CHANGELOG.md has ### Added at line 10, ### Fixed at 222 and ### Changed at 239. A deadline raise is a Change. Fix: Put the entry under ### Changed at line 239 only.

summary: I recommend accepting the plan. It does what the request asks, and the files it names are where it says. athena.toml line 31 reads `producer_timeout_s = 1800`, and the other [budget] values are unchanged. The last entry in docs/decisions.md is D123 (heading at line 3058), so D124 is the right next number. CHANGELOG.md has a `### Changed` section under [Unreleased] at line 239. I checked by reading the files that the config test can pass with the new value. That test is crates/athena-data/tests/repo_config.rs. No test asserts the literal 1800 for this field, and nothing in config.rs caps it. The other 1800 mentions in the docs are historical: D113 near decisions.md line 2663, CHANGELOG line 305 and a design review. They are rightly left alone. The plan gives the decision entry the request's alternatives (each marked queued), a reversal, and the reported 5 to 10 minute figure labeled as not measured. The work fits easily in one producer run. My three findings are small: name the config test when running it, explain why docs/system-facts.md is left unchanged, and use one CHANGELOG insertion point.
